routes.name: Entry visa (check Home Affairs list)
routes.summary: Entry rules depend on your passport. The official visa-free list could not be read. The eVisa system is shown as suspended, and visa applications go by email.

other: Visa-free list, fees and stay length not confirmed on an official page.
Home Affairs site says to email VISA-Applications.Immigration@gov.ls for online applications, phone +266 8005 0074.

routes.name: Residence permits
routes.summary: Categories include missionaries, business, joining a relative, spouse joining a spouse, returning former citizens, doctors and nurses, and teachers. Permits come as 90 days, 2 years, or an indefinite permit.

other: Requirements and fees not listed. Fees are set by the Aliens Control (Amendment of Schedule) Regulations, 2018.
No general work permit details were found on an official page.

routes.name: Citizenship by naturalization or marriage
routes.summary: Non-Basotho who have lived lawfully in Lesotho for five or more years may apply. Since 2018, dual citizenship is allowed. Similar rules apply to spouses of citizens.

other: Language test and other conditions not listed on the page.
